summer.label: Summer
tips: Pick loose, breathable fits so air can move.
Light colours reflect heat and keep you cooler.
Carry a water bottle and use sunscreen.

winter.label: Winter

layer.women: Wool coat or puffer jacket with a thermal inner layer
layer.men: Overcoat or puffer jacket with a thermal inner layer
layer.unisex: Oversized puffer or wool coat with a thermal inner layer

tips: Layer up: thin base layer, warm middle layer, wind-proof outer layer.
Keep your head, hands and feet warm first.
Closed shoes or boots with good grip.
avoid: Thin cotton as the only layer

monsoon.label: Monsoon / Rainy

layer.women: Light hooded rain jacket or trench coat
layer.men: Light hooded rain jacket or windcheater
layer.unisex: Packable rain poncho or hooded windcheater

tips: Choose fabrics that dry fast and don't turn see-through.
Ankle-length or cropped bottoms stay out of puddles.
Waterproof shoes or rubber sandals save your footwear.

spring.label: Spring
tips: Mornings can be cool, so carry one light layer.
Florals and soft pastels match the season.
Mix textures like denim with cotton.

autumn.label: Autumn / Fall

layer.unisex: Chunky knit sweater or trench coat

tips: Earthy colours look great in autumn light.
Layer a sweater over a shirt for an easy smart look.
Boots work for both style and changing weather.

women.name: Elegant guest
pieces: Flowy floor-length gown in a jewel tone

men.name: Classic suit
pieces: Two-piece suit in navy or grey

unisex.name: Tailored set
pieces: Matching suit or jumpsuit in a soft colour

india.name: India
india.styleNote: A mix of rich traditional wear and modern Indo-western fusion. Bright colours are loved, especially at celebrations.

seasonNotes.summer: Very hot in most regions. Cotton kurtas and light linen are everyday favourites.
seasonNotes.winter: Mild in the south, cold in the north. A shawl or Nehru jacket adds warmth with style.
seasonNotes.monsoon: Heavy rain from June to September. Quick-dry fabrics and waterproof sandals help.
seasonNotes.spring: Pleasant and colourful, the season of Holi. Light fabrics in bright shades.
seasonNotes.autumn: Festival season (Navratri, Diwali). Time to bring out festive wear.

women.wedding: Silk saree or a lehenga in red, pink or gold
women.festival: Anarkali suit or a festive saree
women.office: Cotton kurta with straight pants and a dupatta

men.wedding: Sherwani or a kurta with a Nehru jacket
men.office: Formal shirt, trousers, or a Nehru jacket on special days

unisex.wedding: Long embroidered kurta with a Nehru jacket
unisex.casual: Khadi cotton shirt with loose pants

etiquette: Cover shoulders and knees when visiting temples, and remove shoes.
Avoid wearing all-white or all-black to a wedding; bright colours are welcome.
Modest outfits are appreciated in smaller towns.

usa.name: United States
usa.styleNote: Comfort-first and casual in daily life, with a strong love for denim, sneakers and athleisure.

seasonNotes.summer: Hot and humid in many states. Shorts, tees and sundresses are normal.
seasonNotes.winter: Very cold in the north and mild in the south. Puffers and boots are standard up north.
seasonNotes.monsoon: Rainy spells, especially in the Pacific Northwest. A good rain jacket is key.
seasonNotes.spring: Mild and changeable. Layering is the way to go.
seasonNotes.autumn: Classic sweater weather with flannels, boots and fall colours.

women.festival: Red, white and blue for the 4th of July, or cosy knits at Thanksgiving

men.festival: Flannel shirt and jeans for Thanksgiving, or a patriotic tee for the 4th of July

unisex.festival: Team jersey for game day, or cosy fall layers for Thanksgiving

etiquette: Wedding invitations often state a dress code (black tie, cocktail, casual); follow it.
Never wear white to a wedding unless asked.
Business casual is common in offices outside finance and law.

uk.name: United Kingdom
uk.styleNote: Classic tailoring meets street style. Trench coats, knitwear and smart boots are staples.

seasonNotes.summer: Mild and unpredictable. Bring a light jacket even on sunny days.
seasonNotes.winter: Cold, damp and dark. A good wool coat and waterproof boots are essential.
seasonNotes.monsoon: Rain is common all year. A trench coat or packable rain jacket is a must.
seasonNotes.spring: Cool and showery. Layers and a compact umbrella.
seasonNotes.autumn: Crisp and wet. Knitwear and ankle boots.

women.wedding: Smart dress with a fascinator or hat for a formal day wedding

men.wedding: Morning suit for very formal weddings, or a tailored lounge suit

unisex.wedding: Tailored suit with a statement hat or fascinator

etiquette: Hats and fascinators are common at formal weddings and the races.
Smart-casual is a safe choice for most restaurants.
Always pack for rain.

japan.name: Japan
japan.styleNote: Neat, minimal and well-fitted, with bold street-style scenes in Tokyo and Osaka.

seasonNotes.summer: Hot and very humid. Breathable cotton and linen, plus a small towel.
seasonNotes.winter: Cold, especially in the north. Long coats and thin warm layers like heat-tech.
seasonNotes.monsoon: Tsuyu rainy season in June and July. Compact umbrellas are everywhere.
seasonNotes.spring: Cherry blossom season. Soft pastels and light trench coats.
seasonNotes.autumn: Cool and beautiful. Earthy tones and light knits.

women.festival: Cotton yukata with a bright obi belt (summer matsuri)
women.wedding: Formal dress in a soft colour, or a kimono for close family

men.festival: Yukata or jinbei for summer festivals
men.wedding: Dark suit with a white tie

unisex.festival: Jinbei set or yukata for summer festivals

etiquette: Wear socks without holes; you often remove shoes indoors.
Office dress is conservative: dark suits and plain colours.
Revealing outfits are less common than in the West.

uae.name: United Arab Emirates
uae.styleNote: Luxury and modest fashion side by side. Elegant, covered silhouettes are respected.

seasonNotes.summer: Extremely hot outside but icy air-conditioning inside. Light fabrics plus a thin layer.
seasonNotes.winter: Pleasant and mild, perfect for outdoor evenings. A light jacket at night.
seasonNotes.monsoon: Rain is rare. Treat it as a mild season and dress light.
seasonNotes.spring: Warm and pleasant. Breathable, modest outfits.
seasonNotes.autumn: Still hot, cooling slowly. Light, covered outfits.

women.wedding: Embellished abaya or a long modest gown
women.festival: Elegant kaftan or abaya for Eid

men.wedding: Kandura with a ghutra, or a formal suit

unisex.festival: Long linen kaftan or tunic set for Eid

etiquette: Cover shoulders and knees in malls and public places.
Swimwear belongs at the beach or pool only.
Wear modest, loose outfits when visiting mosques; women should cover their hair.

france.name: France
france.styleNote: Effortless chic: neutral colours, quality basics and one standout piece.

seasonNotes.summer: Warm and sunny in the south. Linen dresses, shirts and espadrilles.
seasonNotes.winter: Cold and grey in Paris. A camel coat and a scarf are the classic look.
seasonNotes.monsoon: Rainy spells in spring and autumn. A trench coat is very French.
seasonNotes.spring: Mild and fresh. Breton stripes and light jackets.
seasonNotes.autumn: Cool and stylish. Knitwear, ankle boots and trench coats.

women.festival: Breton stripe top with a red scarf for Bastille Day

men.festival: Breton stripe shirt with chinos for Bastille Day

unisex.festival: Navy-and-white Breton stripes for Bastille Day

etiquette: Gym wear in the city is frowned on; aim for neat and simple.
Less is more: fewer, better pieces.
Dress up a little for dinner out.

nigeria.name: Nigeria
nigeria.styleNote: Bold prints, rich fabrics and proud traditional wear. Ankara prints are everywhere.

seasonNotes.summer: Hot all year. Light, breathable Ankara cotton is perfect.
seasonNotes.winter: Harmattan season brings dry, dusty air. Light layers and moisturiser.
seasonNotes.monsoon: Rainy season from April to October. Quick-dry prints and closed sandals.
seasonNotes.spring: Warm. Bright prints and light fabrics.
seasonNotes.autumn: Warm and humid. Breathable traditional or modern pieces.

women.wedding: Iro and buba with a gele head-tie, often in matching 'aso ebi' colours

men.wedding: Agbada or senator outfit with a fila cap

unisex.wedding: Ankara print kaftan in the event's aso ebi colour
unisex.festival: Ankara print shirt with plain trousers

etiquette: At weddings, guests often wear the chosen 'aso ebi' fabric; ask the hosts.
Dressing up is a sign of respect at events.
Modest outfits are expected in religious places.

south-korea.name: South Korea
south-korea.styleNote: Trend-led K-fashion: clean layers, oversized fits and neat, polished looks.

seasonNotes.summer: Hot and humid. Loose linen and cotton, often in neutral colours.
seasonNotes.winter: Very cold and dry. Long padded coats are the signature look.
seasonNotes.monsoon: Jangma rainy season in July. Rain boots and umbrellas.
seasonNotes.spring: Mild with some yellow dust. Light trench coats and pastel knits.
seasonNotes.autumn: Crisp and clear, the best season for layered outfits.

women.festival: Hanbok with a full skirt (chima) and short jacket (jeogori) for Chuseok or Seollal
women.wedding: Elegant dress in a soft colour

men.festival: Hanbok with a vest and baggy trousers for Chuseok or Seollal
men.wedding: Neat suit in navy or grey

etiquette: Shoulder-baring tops are less common than short skirts.
Neat and well-groomed is valued in offices.
Avoid white flowers or all-black at happy events.

brazil.name: Brazil
brazil.styleNote: Relaxed, bright and body-confident, with lots of colour and beach-ready style.

seasonNotes.summer: Hot (December to March). Light dresses, shorts and sandals.
seasonNotes.winter: Mild in the north, cool in the south. A light jacket is usually enough.
seasonNotes.monsoon: Tropical downpours in summer. Quick-dry fabrics and Havaianas.

women.festival: Bright, colourful outfit with glitter for Carnival, or a checked dress for Festa Junina

men.festival: Bright shirt for Carnival, or a plaid shirt and straw hat for Festa Junina

unisex.festival: Colourful Carnival outfit, or plaid and a straw hat for Festa Junina

etiquette: Brazilian seasons are opposite to the northern hemisphere.
Dressing up for evenings out is common.
Business wear is lighter because of the heat.

australia.name: Australia
australia.styleNote: Laid-back, sunny and outdoorsy. Smart-casual works almost everywhere.

seasonNotes.summer: Hot with strong sun (December to February). Hats and UV-protective clothing.
seasonNotes.winter: Mild in the north, cold in the south. Light coats and knits.
seasonNotes.monsoon: Wet season in the tropical north. Quick-dry clothes.
seasonNotes.spring: Warm and breezy. Floral dresses and light shirts.

women.festival: Light summer dress for a Christmas barbecue on the beach

men.festival: Linen shirt and shorts for a summer Christmas barbecue

unisex.festival: Light linen set for summer Christmas celebrations

etiquette: Seasons are opposite to the northern hemisphere.
Sun protection is a must: hat, sunglasses and sunscreen.
Smart-casual is fine for most restaurants.
